name: app.vercel.warrant-agent-check/checks
title: Warrant checks: Concordium agent badge and Base address facts
description: Paid checks before an agent pays a counterparty: Concordium agent badge and Base address facts.

tools.name: check_concordium_agent
tools.description: Is there an accountable human behind this Concordium agent? Returns whether its Verified by Concordium badge is valid and the owner account. Costs $0.005 in USDC on Base.

badge.description: The agent's CIS-8004 token address in the Concordium Agent Registry.

tools.name: inspect_base_address
tools.description: Facts about a Base address before you pay it or buy its token: wallet or contract, upgradeable proxy, owner, and whether it can mint, pause or blocklist. Costs $0.005 in USDC on Base.

address.description: A 0x address on Base mainnet: a wallet, a contract or a token.

tools.name: preflight_x402_endpoint
tools.description: Before you pay an x402 seller: is the endpoint up, does it ask for real Circle USDC, how much, and what is the address that receives the money. Costs $0.005 in USDC on Base.

url.description: The full https URL of the paid x402 endpoint you are about to call.
